theme_and_archetype.description: A healing, calming, gentle design tailored for individuals managing depression. Uses soothing pastels, warm creams, sage greens, and gentle blues to promote tranquility. Avoids all harsh contrasts, sharp edges, and over-stimulating visuals.

typography.description: Nunito is a well-balanced, rounded sans-serif font that feels approachable, friendly, and non-intimidating.

guidelines: Use extremely generous padding (24px - 32px) around main content areas to reduce cognitive load.
Avoid sharp corners completely. Cards should use 24px radius, buttons should be pill-shaped.
Ensure minimum touch target size is 48x48px for all interactive elements.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped, #A3C4BC background, #2D3142 text, 56px height. Use soft floating shadow.
buttons.emotion_picker: Circular button (64x64px), background color maps to emotion color palette, centered icon. Active state adds a 2px border of the same color with 4px offset.

cards.base: White background, 24px border radius, soft_card shadow, 24px internal padding.
cards.journal_entry: Soft pastel background depending on logged mood (10% opacity of emotion color), no shadow, 16px border radius.

inputs.text: Background #F0EFEB, no border, 16px border radius, 16px padding. On focus, add 2px #A3C4BC border.
inputs.journal_textarea: Same as text input but minHeight 120px, textAlignVertical 'top'.

calendar.style: Use react-native-calendars. Hide standard borders. Day markers should be perfectly round colored dots/backgrounds corresponding to the primary emotion logged that day. Use soft pastel fills for the days.
calendar.header: Bold Nunito font, centered, no arrows (use swipe) or very soft pastel arrows.

image_urls.description: Multicolored pastel abstract painting, very soft, good for login/welcome screen background
Blue pink and green textile pastel gradient, very calm, good for empty states or profile headers
White sand dunes at sunset, minimalist and peaceful

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, specifying the role (e.g., login-submit-button, emotion-happy-picker, toggle-community-share).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Avoid pure white on pure black. Use charcoal #2D3142 for text against pastel backgrounds to maintain AAA readability while keeping a soft emotional tone.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Expo React Native app. Do not use web HTML tags (div, span) or Tailwind CSS classes. Use React Native StyleSheet, Views, Texts, and Pressables.
For icons, strictly use @expo/vector-icons/Feather. See the emotion_mapping block for exact icon names corresponding to emotions.
The mood tracker should display emotions as a horizontal or wrap-around flex layout of large circular touchables with the emotion icon inside.
When an emotion is selected, transition to a journaling screen where the background gently tints to the color of the selected emotion.
Use react-native-calendars for the calendar tab. Customize the 'dayComponent' or 'markedDates' to show the specific emotion color for that day.
Implement navigation using react-navigation bottom tabs. Ensure the active tab icon color is the primary brand color (#A3C4BC) and inactive is disabled grey (#B0B3C1).
Store the JWT in Expo SecureStore after login/registration.
In the Community feed, use 'Anonymous' as the default display name. Add a soft, gentle heart icon for users to show support on posts.
